comment.text: Button label used in the AI service dialog footer and the AI settings banner to trigger the activation of AI capabilities.

usage.context:
<ModalDialog.Footer>
 <Button
 label={
 !isCardLinkedToPortal
 ? t("TopUpAndActivate")
 : t("ActivateAIFeatures")
 }
 size={ButtonSize.normal}
 onClick={onActivate}
 primary
 isLoading={isActivating}
